name: PandaSet — Hesai and Scale AI Open Dataset
description: Public autonomous driving benchmark created by Scale AI and Hesai Technology, captured in complex urban environments in Silicon Valley (San Francisco and El Camino Real). Utilizes a unique sensor configuration combining Hesai PandarGT mechanical LiDAR, forward-facing Pandar64 solid-state LiDAR, and 6 synchronized cameras. Features comprehensive 3D bounding box annotations and fine-grained point cloud semantic segmentation across complex lighting and urban traffic scenarios.
